blacklistabilityReview.evidence: FinChain Dollar resolves to Yes because metadata classifies the asset as a centralized, licensed issuer stablecoin and the token is issued through issuer-managed deployments.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: FinChain's existing on-chain review identifies CCIP bridge pools among the FUSD minter set, and the issuer documents multichain FUSD deployments. Because cross-chain supply movement depends on Chainlink CCIP messaging/pools, FUSD is scored as external-validated-network.
bridgeRouteRisk.reviewer: Codex bridge route review; Kimi P2 control cohort dc-7 (lead pyusd-paypal)

routes.reviewNote: Native FUSD on Ethereum: 2,739-byte EIP-1967 proxy (impl 0x27d2f80fdb8102044897d006c921645c8da92de0, admin = ProxyAdmin 0x29A48097055d6779e6832355680B7C7bF0D43C53). Mint authority is FinChain's mint proxy 0x561bc4f174e04d057c9ce7ae763bc18be7fa3107 plus bridge senders (mint-authority review, read 2026-07-20).

FUSD on avalanche is minted by Chainlink CCIP BurnMint token pools: getRoleMember enumeration (MINTER_ROLE, read 2026-07-20) lists 0xa2b31f91fd83efa022bb79934c6c3d24d044b0f1, 0xc73a36ec9950530256c051b3740412a067f64589 (15,818-byte CCIP pool contracts), alongside the shared FinChain mint proxy 0x561bc4f174e04d057c9ce7ae763bc18be7fa3107 and TokenBridgeSender 0x2f36c915af812ff06742468f206030fcad4c4242. The same CCIP pool owner families (0x914d7fec…, 0xc61f22aa…) operate the pools on every chain.
